title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper. Ready in just 20 minutes!
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a pan until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated cheeses and plenty of black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving some pasta water. Add hot pasta to the pan with pancetta and toss.
Remove from heat, quickly pour in egg mixture and toss vigorously. Add a splash of pasta water if needed to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken cooked in a smooth, buttery & creamy tomato based gravy. Served best with naan.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spice mix for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked; set aside.
In a pan, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken; simmer for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Classic Pancakes
summary: Fluffy homemade pancakes perfect for breakfast. Serve with maple syrup and fresh berries.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In another bowl, beat milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined (batter may be lumpy).
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on surface, then flip and cook until golden.
Serve warm with syrup and berries.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: Crisp romaine lettuce, crunchy croutons, and parmesan cheese with our signature Caesar dressing.
instructions: Whisk all dressing ingredients together.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, croutons, and parmesan.
Toss with dressing just before serving.
